data.name: Hana
data.detailed_description:
Hana is a 3D top-down tactical MMORPG where you play as a Hanari, a race of elves whose civilization has been decimated. Confront formidable adversaries solo or with your friends, develop your guild, your commerce, and rebuild the Hanaris civilization.

MMORPG

Play solo or with your friends in a living, persistent world.

Create your guild, trade with other players, hunt for resources, confront other adventurers in PvP, or explore the most dangerous dungeons in cooperative PvE.

Tactical Combat

Embark on a conquest of the Hana universe! Confront monsters and adventurers in turn-based tactical battles, hone your skills and strategy, and etch your name among the legends of Hana.

Systemic Gameplay and Dynamic Economy

Hana features a dynamic game system where every player action influences the world. Based on player actions, environments transform, resource distribution evolves, and systemic events are triggered. Thanks to destructible elements and living environments, the world constantly reacts, creating immersive and ever-evolving gameplay.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game is set in a fantasy universe and features combat against creatures, monsters, and humanoid enemies. Violence is present within an epic and fantastical context. Blood effects may appear during combat, but they are non-realistic, non-detailed, and not excessive, with no dismemberment.

The story explores mature themes such as the fall of civilizations, world corruption, conflicts between factions, character death, and moral choices that may influence the narrative. These elements are handled in a stylized and narrative manner, without explicit or shocking scenes.

The game does not include sexual content, explicit nudity, sexual assault, non-consensual sexual acts, or self-harm.
Alcohol consumption may be referenced occasionally within the game world (such as taverns or celebrations), without emphasis or encouragement.

All content is presented in an artistic framework consistent with fantasy MMORPG conventions.
